title: Parking License Addendum — The Early Cancellation Fee
content:
Early cancellation fee clause of the Parking License Addendum.

## Clause

When, at the notice date, the whole months from the license's start date are fewer than the commitment months, an early cancellation fee is billed with the notice; when they are not, no early cancellation fee is billed. The commitment months are the product's minimum commitment months. The early cancellation fee is the fee months times the fee base, rounded half up to the cent. The fee months are the product's early cancellation fee months. The fee base is the monthly fee in force on the license.

## Terms used

- **Whole months** are complete months counted from the license's start date up to the notice date. A license started on 15 January has completed 2 whole months on 14 April and 3 whole months on 15 April.
- **Monthly fee in force** is the monthly license fee recorded on the license (before any discount credit).

## Whether a fee is owed

| Whole months from the start date at the notice date | Compared with the commitment months | Early cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|
| fewer | below | billed with the notice |
| equal | not fewer | none |
| more | not fewer | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical product and license)

A product with a minimum commitment of 3 months and an early cancellation fee of 1.00 month; the license's monthly fee in force is $65.00; the license started on 15 January.

- Notice signed on 14 April: 2 whole months, fewer than 3, so a fee is owed. The fee is 1.00 multiplied by $65.00, that is $65.00.
- Notice signed on 15 April: 3 whole months, not fewer than 3, so no fee is owed.
